description: This file defines a Bootstrap carousel component, including the Carousel class, plugin definition, and data API for controlling carousel behavior on web pages.

classes.name: Carousel
classes.description: A class managing carousel behavior such as cycling, sliding, and navigation.

methods.name: cycle
methods.description: Starts automatic cycling of the carousel based on the interval.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Navigates to a specific slide position.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Goes back to the previous slide.

methods.name: slide
methods.description: Performs the slide transition to the specified slide.
